description: The product's passport: the brand's own listing as the baseline (price per size or style, options, availability), then every other Shopify store selling the same product, each marked same item, likely same item, or not the same (customized, bundle, refill or mini, accessory, used) with the evidence for the match and how its price compares with the brand's. Works from the brand's listing or any reseller's. Use it to tell a shopper whether to buy direct, who is cheaper, and which listings to avoid. Prices and stock come from the live Shopify catalog at the time of the call. Checkout happens on the seller's own Shopify store; Coreplex adds no fees.

product_url.description: A Shopify product URL (from search_products seller_url), from the brand or any reseller.
